 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Expand a square grid into four quadrants containing its rotations."""
    n = len(grid)
    if any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("Expected a square grid")

    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]

    return [
        list(grid[r]) + clockwise[r]
        for r in range(n)
    ] + [
        counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r]
        for r in range(n)
    ]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test = [
        [1, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 5, 6],
        [7, 3, 6, 7, 3, 6, 5, 6],
        [6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 5, 1],
        [6, 4, 6, 5, 6, 6, 6, 6],

        [4, 3, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6],

        [5, 7, 7, 6, 9, 4, 8, 8, 7, 7],
        [1, 7, 7, 7, 1, 9, 8, 7, 5, 1],
    ]

    print("demo verified")
